title: Tanker Louise 1 hit by explosives in Strait of Hormuz, crew safe
excerpt: The Panama flagged tanker suffered an engine room fire after two devices were attached by a small boat northeast of Khasab, UKMTO said.

notes: Lead: the vessel hit by explosives is the Panama flagged tanker Louise 1, 25 nautical miles northeast of Khasab on 29 October at 22:12 UTC. Name her in the headline, standfirst, lede, key points and tweet, keep the crew safe wording, the engine room fire put out and her continuing to the next port, and credit UKMTO for the attack and the name to Seatrade Maritime, which had it from Vanguard Tech.

Black Sea: the Contship Jet paragraph must name her and say she sank. She is a Liberia flagged container ship of 1,267 teu carrying 421 containers from Haifa to Constanta, struck by three sea drones on 28 October about 17 nautical miles east of Cape Kaliakra, with all 18 crew rescued and no deaths. Credit Contships Management, the Bulgarian government and Reuters, and do not call her a general cargo ship.

Hormuz claim: the vessel UKMTO reported on fire 9 nautical miles north of Khasab on 29 October was a dhow, identified by regional authorities, with its crew evacuated. Do not present that fire as one of the three tankers the IRGC claims; give the IRGC claim in its own sentence as unconfirmed, with no official body credited for it.
